$description: Semantic colour tokens, mode "today": the default theme (:root), which reproduces the colours the components render today. Names are the Figma names (property/group/role) for Figma-defined tokens and the code name for code-only additions (listed in semantic.config.json). A value is an alias of a primitive ({color.*}) wherever one exists; a literal colour where today uses a colour no primitive holds (shadow tints); a colour with a `mix` extension where today mixes a primitive with transparent (DTCG has no colour modifier, so the value is the equivalent sRGB colour with alpha and `mix` names the primitive and percentage the CSS keeps). `evidence` marks a value verified against component code; a token without it holds the rule-derived fallback (same step of today's ramp), reproduced by the generator.
